reviews.title: Used to be good, now sucks.  Fox sold out
reviews.text: Terrible app now which FREQUENTLY sends users to wal-mart and amazon. Their thumbnail ads are as bad as a same name candidate.

reviews.title: Was ok but a garbage now
reviews.text:
Revised review: it requires iOS 18, eliminating functionality for older equipment.  There is no reason to upgrade equipment just for this app.

Old review: Love the new app, been waiting for it - not disappointed at all. Really like the 3D weather radar!

reviews.title: Had High Hopes
reviews.text: I was really hoping this would be a good app to use instead of the others I’ve had, but It’s a disappointment for sure. The hourly/daily portion is pretty much a mess. I expected a more professional look, but it looks like the old-time, last-in-the-market, 6:00 news weatherboard.

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: To many ads

reviews.title: User
reviews.text: As worthless as we come to expect! It’s been raining for hours and the app still shows no rain and “radar” shows no rain. Enough rain to soak me through in a matter of minutes. The problem is some of us actually work and play outside and others can’t comprehend the implications of not doing their jobs.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: The app always crashes, doesn’t load or takes a long time to load

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text: They will try to change it but not fast enough to be wrong 90% of the time.

reviews.title: Always NOT Working - Not Reliable when You Need It
reviews.text: Not sure what the issue is but there is more times than not that I try to open the app to view the weather and up pops a fox telling me that something went wrong and the app won’t open.  Well, when I need accurate and dependable weather info in a split second I don’t have time to close the app, open the app and hope it’s working.  This is, of course, after I purchased the yearly subscription.  Well, you can have my money this time but you’ll never get it again.  This is not a weather app that is trustworthy when you need it.

reviews.title: Weather App or Logo Marketing???
reviews.text:
It’s obvious no one from FOX reads these reviews. They don’t  respond to what the public’s says. Not one come back of maybe saying we will look into it or we are aware.  Maybe if they told the public what’s going on it would help potential customers thinking of getting the app.

Well months have gone bye and no change. Does anyone with Fox care. I have written more than once about the radar and nothing. I don’t  like CNN but I notice their app is more popular than Fox. Oh well there are quite a few free apps that do more and respond that I will continue to use, sorry FOX wake up…

reviews.title: Frustrated
reviews.text: As a Fox News fan I get quite frustrated when directed on an article on Fox News to their weather app only to find myself having to scroll and search for the article I was interested in. Just direct me directly to the article and then perhaps I would be willing to look at some of the other news worthy articles. Just don’t me make have to scroll and search for what interests me!

reviews.title: Guessing
reviews.text: The weather forecasters of old were better at predicting the forthcoming weather than present day folks with all their weather instruments.  The forecast can change every hour from what I suppose comes about from somebody actually looking at just the radar and a glance out the window.

reviews.title: Sometimes weather.
reviews.text: 0530  I need to see the weather not rock climbing in Utah.

reviews.title: Click bare
reviews.text: Often, when I see a headline I am interested in, it takes me to the Fox weather app. But no article!!!

reviews.title: Dislike pop up ads
reviews.text: Enjoyed the app for months until the pop up ads started appearing on the radar. Ruins the entire experience. Most recently, “something went wrong. Try again later” message appears. The forecast can be unreliable at times.

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: It takes me to this app often from Fox News app, however it never takes me to the story.  Only to the current weather page

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Every time I’m reading the news and an article even slightly mentioned weather I get redirected to the weather site and rarely do I get to read the article. Bad connection or whatever.

reviews.title: Basic app by Fox
reviews.text: Just like every app that Fox puts out this weather app thinks it knows what’s best for you. I tried to shut off some settings in the notification area and they kept coming back on. Won’t let me shut them off no matter what I tried. Had no problem deleting app.

reviews.title: Wrong again
reviews.text: Forecast sucks

reviews.title: Not accurate at all!
reviews.text: There’s an insane difference between FOX weather and Apple weather. Like crazy differences between the two. And it’s the same with every other weather entity!

reviews.title: Loved this app…but…
reviews.text: I have loved using this app for years, but now it stopped working on my iPad Pro 2G. It also seems I’ve recently been beleagured by ads to upgrade. They also do not provide support. Most unfortunate…it’s sad to see such a nice app resort to the useless app bin!

reviews.title: 90% wrong
reviews.text: I do not find this app reliable, I know forecasting is about predictions, but with today’s technology I feel you guys could be more accurate! The last two mornings my notifications have told me to layer up, it’s going to be 94 degrees! 😂😰

reviews.title: Dramatic
reviews.text: Just give the weather and news without a lot of dramatic wording. Even my 9 year old granddaughter noticed how bad it is. Daily cataclysmic events, smh.

reviews.title: The Fox Weather App is one I can count on
reviews.text: I like the Fox Weather App because of its accuracy. There are other popular apps out there but you just can’t count on their forecasts.

reviews.title: Confused
reviews.text: I tapped on a story on the FoxNews app about earthquakes occurring in a certain state and I wanted to find out what state. So when I tapped on it to see, it took me to the current weather forecast. Not the story I wanted to see about the earthquakes. I think it should have taken me to the story that I wanted to see, not what it thought I should see instead.

reviews.title: Do they use their own APP
reviews.text: Horrible. Whenever a story from Fox  turns into a story from Fox Weather, I just close it. The APP takes up WAY too much screen, making it difficult, if not, impossible at times to scroll. You guys are are reaching, trying to get articles on the weather app. There is no need for this app.

reviews.title: Poor map display
reviews.text: Your old display for weather fronts, storms and the like was very good

reviews.title: Worthless
reviews.text: The WORST WEATHER APP IN THE WORLD. IF TODAY IS MONDAY THESE WEATHER IDIOTS COULD NOT PREDICT THE NEXT DAY IS TUESDAY. BETTER OFF NOT PAYING $2.00 and placing a rock on the lawn or look up at the sky for a FAR MORE ACCURATE FORECAST. NOT WORTH 1 STAR.

reviews.title: Story Links
reviews.text: Stories linked on Fox News go to weather home page, not the article. You have to scroll to find it.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: The radar only works until you have a big life threatening storm and then it does nothing. The weather isnt half accurate, this app is absolute garbage.

reviews.title: Not the article
reviews.text: Fox weather has teaser notifications. I select a specific one and the “tease” doesn’t come up.

reviews.title: Hummm
reviews.text:
Not accurate.. not reliable..
As I write this review.. says rain starting in 40 min… as it’s pouring now.. quite common

reviews.title: No Ads Please
reviews.text: Why all the constant advertisements?  There are plenty of weather apps to choose from.

reviews.title: STOP with the vague article titles.
reviews.text: There are so interesting articles BUT…..stop the annoying vague titles like the one today indicating beaches in this state are closed due to fecal matter in the water. What state? I’m on the WEST COAST! Now ask me if I give a damn about a closed beach in Massachusetts? State the location in your title! Yeah yeah I know, you care more about clicks than your integrity.

reviews.title: Question!
reviews.text: Why can’t you get the rain percentages right.  You are usually so off the mark.

reviews.title: Too many commercials
reviews.text: Too many commercials, too much meteorology education, not enough what when and where
